summary: End-to-end validation of the new Lexikon (Stage 1) at mobile viewport 390x844. VERIFIED PASS: open-lexicon from library-tab-lexicon → /lexicon with lexicon-screen; lexicon-progress reads '8 von 135 geplanten Artikeln ausgearbeitet'. lexicon-search returns lex-article-passa for 'Pessach', lex-article-see-genezareth for 'Kinneret', lex-article-abraham for 'Abram'. Filter chips lex-kind-person (1 Treffer: Abraham), lex-epoch-exil (1), lex-region-galilaea (2), lex-book-2Kö (4). lexicon-plan-toggle shows all planned entries; plan-noah is disabled with label suffix '· in Arbeit' and aria-disabled=true, plan-abraham is enabled and opens /lexicon/abraham. On /lexicon/abraham: article-title, article-disambiguation visible, article-level-overview/deep toggle extends toc from 7 to 11 headings (adds Bindung Isaaks, Historische Einordnung, Entstehung der Texte, Auslegung, Zum Nachdenken), article-toc chips rendered, 8 ref-<ref> chips present. Clicking 'ref-1Mo 11,27–32' opens ref-preview-sheet with ref-preview-text (790 chars Elberfelder 1905 text — backend /api/bible OK). ref-open-bible navigates to /bible?b=1Mo&ch=11&v=27&lex=abraham and lexicon-return-button (count=1) returns to /lexicon/abraham. article-fav toggle persists through hard reload (biblia_state contains 'abraham'); /lexicon index then shows the 'Favoriten' and 'Zuletzt gelesen' sections. article-note-input + article-note-save persists 'Test Notiz Abraham' through hard reload. On /lexicon/assyrien: article-map-section + article-map render; map-state-0/1/2 chips all present and update map-state-note (e.g. 'Unter Asarhaddon zeitweise bis nach Ägypten; größte Ausdehnung.'). map-fullscreen opens article-map-full modal; article-place-list-toggle lists article-place-{jerusalem,nineveh,babylon,carchemish,tahpanhes,assur}; tapping a place yields article-map-selected. On /lexicon/abraham rel-jakob correctly opens an info sheet (jakob is in INFO_BY_ID, not ARTICLES). Lernreisen flow: BEFORE touching /station/john-3, /lexicon/hochzeit-kana shows discover-john-3 (article-discover=1, article-journeys=0); after visiting /station/john-3 and clicking 'Weiter' (station-next-button), biblia_state now contains 'john-3', and /lexicon/hochzeit-kana now shows article-journeys with journey-john-3 (article-discover removed). Reading the article did not change station progress. Bible flow: /bible?b=Joh&ch=2 → tapping verse-2-1 opens verse-sheet, verse-lexicon section is present with verse-lex-hochzeit-kana, which navigates to /lexicon/hochzeit-kana (article-screen=1). InfoChip flow: library → library-tab-lexicon → info-chip-passa opens info sheet with info-open-article button that navigates to /lexicon/passa. TWO REAL BUGS FOUND: (A) rel-<target> on a lexicon article does NOT navigate when the target is another ARTICLE and we are already on /lexicon/[id] — rel-assyrien on /lexicon/exil fires but URL stays at /lexicon/exil and title remains 'Das Babylonische Exil'. (B) MASSIVE console error flood from ArticleMap / ZoomableMap: dozens of 'Error: <path> attribute d: Expected number, M-Infinity ...', '<rect> attribute y: NaN', '<svg> attribute viewBox: 0 0 Infinity 16', 'Received NaN for the y attribute' etc. Map still renders visually, but the console is spammed on every article with a map. No red screens, no PAGEERROR, all other 'critical' items passed.

ui_bugs.issue: rel-<id> taps that target another ARTICLE never navigate when the user is already on /lexicon/[id]. Reproduced on /lexicon/exil → tap rel-assyrien: URL/title stay on exil. Likely because router.push({ pathname:'/lexicon/[id]', params:{ id:t }}) to the same dynamic route pattern is a no-op in Expo Router — change to a string path like router.push(`/lexicon/${t}`) or use router.replace, or add a key on the screen component. Reference: /app/frontend/app/lexicon/[id].tsx:63

integration_issues.flow: Lexicon article → Lexicon article via relations
integration_issues.issue: Blocked for article↔article relations (only). Article↔info (e.g. rel-jakob) works, and InfoChip→info-open-article→/lexicon/<id> also works, so the regression is isolated to the self-route-push case.

react_native_issues.issue: Dozens of console errors on every article that has a.map: 'Error: <path> attribute d: Expected number, "M-Infinity …"', '<rect> attribute y: Expected length, "NaN"', '<svg> attribute viewBox: Expected number, "0 0 Infinity 16"', 'Received NaN for the `%s` attribute … y'. Caused by rendering before container width/height are measured (initial box=0 → projection yields NaN/Infinity). Guard the projection with isFinite checks or short-circuit render until measured width*height>0. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ArticleMap.tsx:35,47 and /app/frontend/src/components/ZoomableMap.tsx (initial fitT when box is zero).

action_items: FIX HIGH: in /app/frontend/app/lexicon/[id].tsx (line ~63) replace `router.push({ pathname: '/lexicon/[id]', params: { id: t } })` with `router.push(`/lexicon/${t}`)` (or router.replace) so that article→article relations navigate. Current implementation silently no-ops when already on /lexicon/[id].

FIX NOISE/PERF: guard ArticleMap/ZoomableMap/GeoMap projection against NaN/Infinity (e.g. return null while measured size is 0, or clamp box to a finite non-empty rect). This eliminates the massive React/SVG warning flood on every article with map and improves startup rendering.

Verify once the two fixes are in: rel-assyrien from /lexicon/exil, rel-jesaja from /lexicon/exil, rel-passa from /lexicon/jerusalem, and confirm no NaN/Infinity SVG warnings on /lexicon/abraham, /lexicon/assyrien, /lexicon/exil, /lexicon/see-genezareth.
critical_code_review_comments: ArticleScreen reads params with useLocalSearchParams but all state hooks (level, note, SCROLL, pos, restored) key off the OUTER captured a.id. On a successful param-only re-render these would persist from the previous article; so even after fixing router.push, consider adding `key={id}` on the screen or keying local state on id to avoid cross-article state bleed (notes defaulting to the previous article's note, etc.).
ArticleScreen is 213 lines – still fine, but the single giant return JSX has ~15 responsibilities. Consider splitting ArticleHero, ArticleRefs, ArticleRelations, ArticleJourneys, ArticleNote.
RefLinks preview uses backend /api/bible successfully — good; just ensure a graceful fallback text when the fetch fails (currently returns 790 chars happy path, loading state not re-tested).

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only run; /api/bible/translations and /api/bible/1/11 verified 200 OK incidentally)

seed_data_creation: In-session only via localStorage biblia_state: favorited 'abraham', note on abraham='Test Notiz Abraham', advanced station john-3 by one phase.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser automation tool call starts a fresh context (empty localStorage), so seed any required state inside the same script. To mark station john-3 as 'started' without the UI, visit /station/john-3 and press 'Weiter' (testID=station-next-button) — just loading the page does NOT update state.phase. The InfoSheet 'info-open-article' button is only present when the InfoChip target has a full ARTICLE (e.g. passa, abraham, jerusalem, exil, hochzeit-kana, see-genezareth, assyrien, stiftshuette). Ref preview sheet testID is ref-preview-sheet with ref-preview-text and ref-open-bible; after /bible navigation, lexicon-return-button appears in the bible header. Known noise: ArticleMap renders cause many SVG NaN/Infinity warnings; ignore (visual rendering is fine) until the main agent adds a guard.
rca_of_issue: Bug A (rel-<article> no-op): Expo Router treats router.push({ pathname:'/lexicon/[id]', params:{id:t} }) as a replace when the current route pattern is already /lexicon/[id] with the same navigator stack entry, so no new history entry is pushed and the screen is not remounted (and useLocalSearchParams keeps returning the previous params because the Screen instance is reused with a stale key). Fix: use the resolved string path `/lexicon/${t}` (which Expo Router correctly diff's against the current URL) or add `key={id}` on the screen to force remount. Bug B (SVG NaN flood): ArticleMap passes `initial={box}` to ZoomableMap where box=placesBox(map, ids, 0.12). On first render, the ZoomableMap container has not been measured yet (vw/vh=0 or width/height from props may be mis-sized relative to viewBox), so fitT(initial) divides by zero → Infinity, and subsequent projection → NaN. Projected coordinates then flow into <path d>, <rect x/y/w/h>, <circle cy/r>, <ellipse cx/cy/rx/ry>, and the root <svg viewBox>. Guard: short-circuit render until measured width*height>0, or clamp fitT output with Number.isFinite().
